titulo: Fork down until the last plate lands
caption:
Fork down until the last plate lands

Four plates came out, one at a time. She kept her fork down until the last one landed.

Waiting for the last plate costs a minute, and everyone starts at the same moment instead of one by one.

For whoever waits until everyone is served.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. A plate of food sits in front of an ink-black block figure with white eyes that trembles slightly. Three more plates appear one after another along the table. When the last one lands, its eyes turn happy with a pulse and a bubble says dig in! The text changes from: me starting while they're still serving, to: waited for the last plate. we started together.
